project.name: Lash
project.description: Collaborative local-first and realtime writing editor with feature-audit metadata and a hardened insight router.

layers.name: Feature Audit
layers.description: Canonical user-story inventory, audit results, fix logs, and review metadata.

layers.name: Test Harness
layers.description: Unit, Playwright, fixtures, and acceptance tests used to harden user behavior.

layers.name: Web Application
layers.description: Next.js routes, editor workspace components, shell UI, and browser-facing helpers.

layers.name: Editor Domain Packages
layers.description: Editor schema, history, authorship, AI, mentions, share, RBAC, and related domain libraries.

layers.name: Realtime Runtime
layers.description: Cloudflare Durable Object realtime worker, access checks, persistence, routing, and deployment config.

layers.name: Docs and Process
layers.description: Project ledgers, acceptance gates, handoff notes, deployment notes, and planning documents.

layers.name: Config and Infra
layers.description: Build, lint, TypeScript, CI, package, and workspace configuration.

layers.name: Repo Utilities
layers.description: Scripts, Makefile targets, generated graph scaffolding, and miscellaneous support files.

tour.title: Project Contract
tour.description: Start with the product contract and continuity ledger. These files explain what Lash is trying to be and which collaboration claims are already backed by tests.

tour.title: Editor Experience
tour.description: The editor workspace composes the document UI, toolbar, panels, realtime state, local document identity, and persistence bridges.

tour.title: Document Model
tour.description: Core editor packages define schema, markdown behavior, table UX, mention nodes, history, authorship, and patch validation.

tour.title: Collaboration Runtime
tour.description: Realtime collaboration is split between browser bindings and a Cloudflare Durable Object Worker with access checks and append-only persistence.

tour.title: Insight Routing
tour.description: The audit introduced an explicit insight router package that validates payloads and isolates writes to special writing places.

tour.title: Feature Audit Ledger
tour.description: The feature audit artifacts are the canonical spreadsheet-backed inventory of user stories, errors, fixes, deferred work, and independent review.

tour.title: Verification Gates
tour.description: The test harness and CI configuration define how daily behavior, realtime collaboration, and performance claims are kept honest.
